label: Particle text
desc: A word built from thousands of canvas particles that gather into place, are pushed away by the pointer and spring back; click or Enter scatters them, touch gets a drifting ripple.
use: Landing hero word, 404 or empty-state title, brand moment (fills its parent; give it a height).

label: Scroll float
desc: A headline whose letters float up into place with overshoot, tilt and stagger, scrubbed by scroll position.
use: Section headings on long landing pages; works inside a scrolling panel or on the page.

label: Scroll reveal
desc: A passage that comes into focus word by word as you scroll: dim and blurred, then a brand-coloured reading head, then ink, with a progress rail.
use: Manifesto or about paragraphs and long intros; works inside a scrolling panel or on the page.

label: Scroll velocity
desc: Rows of big type that drift at a calm pace and surge, skew and reverse with scroll speed and direction.
use: A divider band between landing sections, client or feature tickers; works inside a scrolling panel or on the page.

label: Shuffle
desc: Letters trade places through several random arrangements of the line, then settle back into reading order; plays on view, hover, tap or Enter.
use: Playful hero headings, section titles, game or event pages.

label: Split-flap text
desc: A departure-board display where each character flips through its drum one flap at a time; cycles a word list or follows the text prop.
use: Status boards, rotating destinations or product names, countdown-style headers.

label: Stroke text
desc: Big outlined type whose gradient stroke draws itself along the glyph contours, then fills in; replays on hover, tap or Enter.
use: Hero words, section openers and brand statements.

label: Tech text
desc: A HUD-style readout with corner brackets, status lamp, scan bar and ruler around monospaced text that decodes out of noise and glitches briefly each pass.
use: Status lines, developer or security product heroes, system banners.

label: Text cursor
desc: Text that types itself, rests, deletes and moves to the next phrase, with a blinking caret you can style as bar, block or underscore.
use: Hero taglines, terminal mockups, rotating value propositions.

label: Text loop
desc: A sentence with one rotating word slot that swaps words by slide, blur or roll while the slot glides to each word's width; pauses on hover, focus or a button.
use: Hero headlines such as 'Ship faster / safer / together'.
